profile.name: Sukalpa Das Shrestha
profile.tagline: Video Editor · Audio Engineer · Podcast Producer
profile.bio: Mechanical Engineering student at Kathmandu University with over 10 years of experience in electronics, robotics, and creative media. I specialise in video editing, audio recording and engineering, podcast production, and event audio management — working with institutions, hydropower companies, and independent creators across Nepal.

services.title: Video Editing
services.description: From raw footage to polished final cut. Corporate events, AGMs, drone footage, documentary, and podcast video for institutions and independent clients.

services.title: Audio Engineering
services.description: Professional recording, mixing, mastering, noise reduction, and sound design. Voice-over narration, music production, and broadcast-ready masters.

services.title: Podcast Production
services.description: End-to-end podcast production — recording, audio engineering, editing, music, and delivery-ready masters. Full service from concept to platform.
